newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAL sees Y28 bln operating profit in 97/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: JAL sees Y28 bln operating profit in 97/98 - paper.

text.p: Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) expects to post a parent operating profit of 28 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, up from its break-even estimate for 1996/97, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.

Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that JAL President Akira Kondo revealed the latest 1997/98 forecast in a news conference on Monday. Company spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the report.
The profit increase was attributed to expected growth in passenger levels and lower labour costs, Nihon Keizai said.
